Calculate the gradient of $AB$ through $A(-1, 1)$ and $B(3, 4)$:
$$m_{AB} = \frac{4 - 1}{3 - (-1)} = \frac{3}{4}$$

Write the equation of the line $BC$ passing through $B(3, 4)$:
$$y - 4 = -\frac{4}{3}(x - 3) \implies y = -\frac{4}{3}x + 4 + 4 \implies y = -\frac{4}{3}x + 8$$

Find the $x$-coordinate of $C$ by setting $y = 0$:
$$-\frac{4}{3}x + 8 = 0 \implies \frac{4}{3}x = 8 \implies x = 8 \times \frac{3}{4} = 6$$

Apply the distance formula between $A(-1, 1)$ and $C(6, 0)$:
$$AC = \sqrt{(6 - (-1))^2 + (0 - 1)^2} = \sqrt{7^2 + (-1)^2} = \sqrt{49 + 1} = \sqrt{50} = 5\sqrt{2} \approx 7.071 \quad (\text{to 3 d.p.})$$
